ضمان عام من الوكيل



Product Name:

Rapoo C260 Full HD 1080p Webcam

Specifications:

  • Resolution: Full HD 1080p (1920 × 1080)

  • Frame Rate: Up to 30 fps

  • Lens: Wide-angle lens

  • Field of View (FOV): ~90°

  • Microphone: Built-in stereo microphone

  • Focus: Fixed focus

  • Connection: USB-A

  • Compatibility: Windows, macOS, Chrome OS

  • Mount: Clip / stand for monitor or laptop

  • Plug & Play: Yes (no drivers required)

Key Features:

  • Crisp and smooth Full HD video quality

  • Easy to set up (USB plug & play)

  • Good audio capture with built-in mic

  • Great for video calls, streaming, online Meeting
